name: scrapenow-mcp

tools.name: get_current_page
tools.description: The web page open in the user's Chrome: URL, title, and whether it's a YouTube video/Short/channel, TikTok video or Instagram post/reel that ScrapeNow can read.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: The user's saved ScrapeNow tables (newest first): id, title, kind, row count, source URL and last update.

tools.name: read_table
tools.description: Rows of a saved table, keyed by the column names the user sees. Use offset/limit to page through large tables. Long cells (like transcripts) are cut to max_chars_per_cell.

include_hidden.description: Also return columns the user hid.

tools.name: edit_columns
tools.description: Changes a saved table's columns the same way the user can in ScrapeNow's Data view: rename (from -> to), hide, show, and/or set the order. Columns are matched by their current name. Rows are never changed.

order.description: Every visible column name in the new order; others keep their place after them.

tools.name: get_video_details
tools.description: Details of a YouTube video/Short, TikTok video or Instagram post/reel: title or caption, account, views/plays, likes, comments, shares, saves, date, length, hashtags, description, tags, thumbnail URL and whether a transcript exists.

url.description: A YouTube, TikTok or Instagram URL. Leave out to use the page the user has open in Chrome.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: The transcript of a YouTube video/Short (from YouTube's transcript panel) or a TikTok video (from its captions). Instagram has none.

url.description: A YouTube, TikTok or Instagram URL. Leave out to use the page the user has open in Chrome.

tools.name: get_thumbnail
tools.description: The thumbnail (YouTube) or cover image (TikTok, Instagram) as an image you can look at, plus its URL.

url.description: A YouTube, TikTok or Instagram URL. Leave out to use the page the user has open in Chrome.

tools.name: save_video_to_table
tools.description: Adds the video or post (with its transcript, unless include_transcript is false) as one row of the user's "Saved videos & posts" table in ScrapeNow. Saving the same URL again updates its row.

url.description: A YouTube, TikTok or Instagram URL. Leave out to use the page the user has open in Chrome.

instructions:
ScrapeNow is a Chrome extension the user runs. These tools read the user's saved ScrapeNow tables and the page open in their Chrome, and can rename or tidy table columns.
- Start with get_current_page or list_tables.
- For YouTube videos and Shorts, TikTok videos and Instagram posts/reels: get_video_details, get_transcript and get_thumbnail (returns the image so you can look at it). Without a url they use the page the user has open.
- To analyse a set of videos, read the "Saved videos & posts" table (save_video_to_table adds the open video to it).
- edit_columns changes the user's table; say what you renamed or hid.
- ScrapeNow never downloads videos.
